shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A woman in a yellow shirt sits at the shelf-side window seat and calls the club meeting to order. A man in a purple shirt occupies the doorway-side window seat, a man in a red shirt sits at the shelf-side aisle seat, and a woman in a green shirt is seated at the doorway-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the shelving unit in frame.

shots.content: The man in a purple shirt leaves his seat and exits the venue. The woman in a yellow shirt asks about the anniversary agenda.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a yellow shirt reviews the written contributions.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the shelf-side window seat.

shots.content: The woman in a green shirt asks about the group anniversary, and the woman in a yellow shirt explains the collective account.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the game table.
